display.purpose: Fraunces serif for h1-h4, product names on hero/cards. Swaps per active festival theme.

body.purpose: Inter sans for paragraphs, labels, buttons, inputs. Never swapped for the serif.

shadows.name: glow-soft
shadows.purpose: Resting-state glow on hero product tiles; barely-there presence cue.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Hover-state glow; the primary interactive depth cue across cards, buttons, and stat tiles.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Standard hover lift paired with the glow shadow on interactive cards and buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold-filled action per view; used for the single most important action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; background: #c99a2e; color: #251a0c; border: none; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #dcae45; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -6px rgba(201,154,46,0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c99a2e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent with a gold border and text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; background: transparent; color: #c99a2e; border: 1px solid rgba(201,154,46,0.4); transition: all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(201,154,46,0.1); border-color: rgba(201,154,46,0.7); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat-at-rest content panel; the universal container for product tiles, order rows, admin stat cards.
components.html:
Beef Pickle

Slow-cooked beef in a dark, peppery masala.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #362a1a; border: 1px solid #4f3f28; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 24px 55px -16px rgba(201,154,46,0.55); border-color: rgba(201,154,46,0.4); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; color: #f6ecd8; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #c7b08b; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — quiet focus cue (border color shift only, no glow).
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #4f3f28; background: #362a1a; color: #f6ecd8; padding: 0 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(199,176,139,0.7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #c99a2e; outline: none; }

components.name: Badge — New
components.description: Gold pill marking a new product.
components.css: .ds-badge-new { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #c99a2e; color: #251a0c; }

components.name: Badge — Best Seller
components.description: Green pill — the one place paddy-field green appears as a signal.
components.css: .ds-badge-best { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #4c7a45; color: #3a2410; }

narrative.overview: Fresh Fusion's storefront reads as a Kerala temple mural at dusk: a deep teak-wood dark background (never pure black), warm kasavu-gold borders and accents, and a signature amber "lamplight" glow that blooms behind product jars and interactive elements instead of a conventional drop shadow. The palette is a temple-mural triad — turmeric gold, mural maroon-red, and paddy-field green — applied with restraint so gold stays the dominant voice and the other two read as accents, not competing protagonists. This is a home-cooked, family-kitchen brand, not a slick FMCG one. The design avoids sterile, corporate polish in favor of warmth: serif display type for headings, a plain humanist sans for body text and UI chrome, and a flat-by-default surface language where depth is conveyed through a glowing light source rather than stacked shadows. The system is also themeable by design: the same token names are redefined wholesale for festival storefront takeovers, each with its own font pairing.
keyCharacteristics: Deep warm-dark background (teak wood, never pure black or navy)
Kasavu-gold as the single dominant accent; maroon-red and palm-green used sparingly
Flat cards with a thin border at rest; warm gold glow appears only on hover/interaction
Serif display (Fraunces) paired with a plain sans body (Inter) — self-hosted
Fully themeable token system that re-skins for festivals without changing component code

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Primary gold is the only color allowed to dominate a screen. Maroon and green exist to mark a single specific state (error, success, best-seller) — never as a second or third "brand" color competing with gold for attention.

rules.name: The Serif-Only-For-Headings Rule
rules.body: Fraunces (or the active theme's display face) never appears in body copy, buttons, or form inputs — those always use the sans body font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a resting-state drop shadow. Shadows exist only as the glow response to hover/interaction state.

dos: Do derive every color from the active theme's CSS custom properties — never hardcode a hex value in a component.
Do use the lamplight glow as the only depth cue on hover; keep rest-state surfaces flat.
Do keep gold as the single dominant accent; reach for maroon or green only for their one specific meaning.
Do pair serif headings with sans body/UI text — never swap them.
donts: Don't add resting-state drop shadows to cards or panels.
Don't introduce a second gold-weight accent color.
Don't use the serif display font for body copy, buttons, or form inputs.
Don't fetch fonts from Google at build time — fonts are self-hosted via Fontsource.
